name: Plumber License
description: How to transfer a plumbing license between US states.
longDescription: Plumbing license types differ between states: some license individual plumbers, others license plumbing contractors. PermitBridge publishes a plumbing transfer page only after checking the requirements against the licensing board's own source.

faqs.question: Does Texas license plumbing companies?
faqs.answer: No. The Texas State Board of Plumbing Examiners licenses individuals, and its rules say a person or company may not offer plumbing to the public "unless the person or company has secured the services of at least one RMP holding a current Master Plumber License" (from the board's compilation of its administrative rules, §367.9).
